newsitem.title: GREECE: ING Barings sets call warrant on Greek index.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings sets call warrant on Greek index.

text.p: ING Baring Financial Products (IBFP) launched American-style, drachma-denominated call warrants on the Athens bourse's benchmark index with Sigma Securities acting as the local placing agent, IFBP said in a statement on Wednesday.
IBFP will issue a total of 4 million warants which will be listed in Luxembourg. Minimum trading size is 20,000 warrants in denominations of 100.

Issue price is 19.0 percent of strike price which is based on the arithmetical mean of the closing values of the Athens Stock Exchange's General Index over the three successive trading days from and including the launch date of May 14, 1997.
The gearing is x5.26 and bid, ask prices will be available on Reuters page BWWB.
The warrants are cash settled and cleared through Euroclear.
